definitions.gloss: rainbow colors; the colors of the rainbow; iridescent
definitions.explanation: The band of colors seen in a rainbow, or something that shows many shifting colors like a rainbow. Often used with の to modify a noun.

examples.japanese: ⟦シャボン{玉|だま}→シャボン玉：27863_shabondama⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{虹色|にじいろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{光|ひか}る→光る：01163_hikaru⟧。
examples.english: The soap bubble shines in rainbow colors.

examples.japanese: ⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{虹色|にじいろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{雲|くも}→雲：02202_kumo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{現|あらわ}れた→現れる：01870_arawareru⟧。
examples.english: A rainbow-colored cloud appeared in the sky.

examples.japanese: ⟦{光|ひかり}→光：01707_hikari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{当|あ}たる→当たる：01860_ataru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、CD⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{裏面|うらめん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{虹色|にじいろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{輝|かがや}いて→輝く：02032_kagayaku⟧⟦{見|み}えた→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: When the light hit it, the back of the CD shimmered in rainbow colors.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{虹|にじ}→虹：03894_niji⟧ (rainbow) + ⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧ (color). Used both for the literal seven-color spectrum and for any iridescent, multi-colored sheen.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {虹色|にじいろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{雲|くも}→雲：02202_kumo⟧: a rainbow-colored cloud
- {虹色|にじいろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{光|ひか}る→光る：01163_hikaru⟧: shine iridescently
- {虹色|にじいろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{輝|かがや}く→輝く：02032_kagayaku⟧: glitter in rainbow colors
